content-yellow.$description: Generic yellow text and icons on a default surface. Also legible on bg-yellow-subtle.

content-yellow-on-color.$description: Generic yellow text and icons for use on a dark or strongly coloured surface. The mode-swapped counterpart of content-yellow.

content-on-yellow.$description: Text and icons drawn on top of bg-yellow. Chosen per hue for contrast — do not substitute a fixed neutral.
